craft_notes: Sthāyin: śeṣavṛtti unit 57. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 6. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Red cotton wool like seed heap are in enjoyment; specials and varied spoken by cause.
l4.sanskrit_cite: raktakarpāsatūlecchustulyatadbījapuñjavat santi bhoge viśeṣāśca vicitrāḥ kāraṇeritāḥ
